citations.title: August 2026 – TrackTik Help Center
excerpts: August 2026

**NEW FEATURE** **Missed tour detection and the Missed status** **Available in:** Security & Patrol > Tour Routes (site and zone level) **What it does** A scheduled tour that has not been started by its missed cutoff is now marked Missed. The two timing values that drive this are set per tour and shown on the Create a Tour form: **Missed cutoff** = scheduled start + estimated tour duration

**NEW FEATURE** **Missed Tour Alert** **Available in:** Security & Patrol > Tour Routes and Checkpoints · Notifications **What it does** The alert picker at site and zone level now offers Late Tour Alert and Missed Tour Alert alongside the existing Tour Finish Alert and Tour Incomplete Alert. The Missed Checkpoint Tour Alert is also available under Notifications, where it can use the default notification settings, no notifications, or a custom rule. Recipients can be added individually and notified by email or SMS.

basis.reasoning: The August 2026 release notes label missed-tour detection, the Missed status and Missed Tour Alert as new features. These add operational capabilities rather than merely fixing bugs or changing presentation, and fall within the six-month window.
